statement.p: Find the flux of the vector field \vec J = 3 y\, \vec i+3 y^2 z\, \vec j out of the closed box 0\le x\le 5, 0\le y\le 3, 0\le z\le 6.

static.solution: \mbox{div }\vec J = 6 y z, if W is the interior of the box, the Divergence Theorem gives \hbox{Flux } = \int_W 6 y z\,dV = \int_0^{6}\int_0^{3}\int_0^{5} 6 y z\,dx\,dy\,dz = \frac{3}{2} x\bigg|_0^{6} y^2\bigg|_0^{3} z^2\bigg|_0^{5} = 2430.
